name: rustc
description: The Rust programming language compiler and toolchain.
build:
cd rustc-1.93.1-src && cat > bootstrap.toml <<'BOOTSTRAP'
change-id = 148795

[llvm]
targets = "X86"

[build]
description = "for NullOS"
docs = false
locked-deps = true
tools = ["cargo", "clippy", "rustdoc", "rustfmt", "src"]

[install]
prefix = "/usr"
docdir = "share/doc/rustc-1.93.1"

[rust]
channel = "stable"
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
llvm-bitcode-linker = false
BOOTSTRAP
./x.py build
